These estimates are calculated by modeling comparable deliveries in the community. The ranges represent historical percentiles: P25 (Fast: 25 percent of orders delivered faster), P50 (Normal: the median/average delivery time), P75 (Slow: 75 percent of orders delivered faster), and P95 (Extreme: 95 percent of orders delivered faster). These are statistical ranges and not absolute minimum or maximum times, nor official Tesla guarantees.
